title: How much do people binge drink in Great Britain?

breadcrumb.text: How much do people binge drink in Great Britain?

body.text: Young adults are commonly associated with binge drinking in the media. However, the latest data about their relationship with alcohol might surprise you, as might the location of the teetotal capital of Great Britain. Here are 5 facts about drinking habits in Great Britain between 2005 and 2013.

body.h4: 1. More than one in five adults in Great Britain in 2013 said they were teetotal. The proportion of teetotal young adults (those aged 16 to 24) increased by over 40% between 2005 and 2013.

body.text: In line with the Government’s Alcohol Strategy, binge drinking refers to men who reported drinking more than eight units of alcohol on their heaviest drinking day in the week before interview, and women who drank more than six units.
